title: PBMCs, Ctrl_1, post ICI, 5' RNA
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from patient peripheral blood and cryopreserved in 90% FBS, 10% DMSO. On the day of library preparation, the cells were thawed and viability sorted by FACS. Single-cell-containing Gel Beads-in-emulsion (GEMs) were generated by loading suspended cells into a 10x Genomics Chromium Controller.
scRNA-seq and TCR-seq libraries were prepared by using 10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Reagent Kits (v2) (CG000331 Rev D)
5' Single Cell V(D)J Phenotyping & Gene Expression
data_processing: Raw-sequencing data were demultiplexed using CellRanger mkfastq. Demultiplexed sequencing reads were aligned to the reference genome GRCh38 using CellRanger Multi (cellranger-6.1.2) from 10x Genomics
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: CellRanger output files: barcodes.tsv.gz; features.tsv.gz; matrix.mtx.gz (from sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix/)
Supplementary files format and content: CellRanger output files: clonotypes.csv; filtered_contig_annotations.csv
